verdict.rationale: Solo 2 ships a CLI (solo2 list, update, admin commands), so bulk operations across many items or devices is a fair question. No evidence shows it performs bulk actions across many credentials or keys at once. Listing connected devices and a remark that one attestation key could go on many devices are adjacent features, not a documented bulk-operation capability.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can perform bulk operations across many items at once
